about: What each persisted interact.json id MEANS (RELEASE_SYSTEM_REVIEW_2026-10-08 H2). Bump `meaning` and set `since` to the release that first ships the new meaning whenever the firmware changes how a saved value is read or written (packing, units, enum, range), even when interact.json does not change. `since` is a release tag with a CHANGELOG heading, or the upcoming release's tag. Baseline: earlier history is not tracked before the first release listed. tools/tau_compat.py reports an id as changed when its `since` is later than the previous release, and refuses a release whose interact.json persists an id missing here or named differently. Never reuse an id: give a new meaning a new id when the format allows it.

10.name: Volume
10.what: volume position 0-100 on the dB taper (B-598); before alpha.4 the same number was a linear gain, so a saved value now sounds quieter

11.name: Color
11.what: accent colour index into the 19-colour Pocket palette

15.name: Meter
15.what: meter = VIZ_* enum number (append-only); since v0.5.0 numbers 2, 7, 9, 11 are retired (7 also saves Bars in its mirrored layout), list order is not enum order

16.name: Halcyon EQ preset
16.what: Halcyon EQ preset index 0-30 (B-651); before, the index of one of the eight legacy preset EQs

20.name: (internal) list 1
20.what: NOT YET RELEASED (Player 2, first ships after v0.6.0-preview.1: set `since` to that release tag when it is cut). Word 0 of 4 of the saved meter tuning (fw2/cores/tune_core.h: check byte, meter, preset, then the parameters that differ from the preset; 31 bits per word, a stale old Check summary fails the check byte and is ignored). Before this it held the saved Check summary (TAUD1) of the old player

27.name: (internal) theme
27.what: theme index (B-346). Until v0.5.0 id 27 was 'Library off (restart)' at another address; the id was reused, contrary to tools/tau_data_slots.py's own rule, so a value saved by v0.5.0 or older must not be read as a theme

28.name: (internal) theme mode
28.what: bit 0 theme polarity (Dark 0, Light 1; since v0.6.0-alpha.1), bits 4-5 ReplayGain mode 0 Off 1 Track 2 Album (B-599, range widened to 255 in B-600)

29.name: (internal) meter presets
29.what: NOT YET RELEASED (Player 2, first ships after v0.6.0-preview.1: set `since` to that release tag when it is cut). The selected preset of each meter, four bits each in the meter table order: Winamp Bars (bits 3-0, 5 presets), Winamp Scope (7-4, 5), Chladni (11-8, 4), Layered Wave (15-12, 8), Master VU (19-16, 3); Player 2 (Select+X cycles); a value out of range reads as the first preset
